annotations.title: Link a system prompt to a component

description: Tie a system prompt source to the agent or subagent it instructs (a component of System knowledge), or untie it with component null, as the Component part of a source on the Sources tab does. Only a system prompt is tied to a component. Name the component exactly; nothing is guessed.

component.description: The agent or subagent the prompt instructs: a component of System knowledge, by its id or exact name. null removes the link.
component.title: Component

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

source.description: The system prompt source's id, as list_sources shows it.
source.title: Source

name: link_source_component
